meta.title: Missing properties quickfix does not add missing imports
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#49009 (fix(49001): handle missing imports in addMissingMember QF), 69214c0e56, 2022-05-09; git tag --contains: first in v4.8-beta / v4.8.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@4.7.4 (2022-06-17) and typescript@4.8.2 (2022-08-25), both behind typescript-language-server@1.1.2 (the latest wrapper release before 4.8.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. The add-missing-properties fix exists since 4.4 (PR #44576, named in the issue), so 4.7.4 offers it.
meta.notes: Two files from one code block of the issue. The fix for TS2741 on 'const bar: Bar = {}' generates 'bar: function (): SomeType' without importing SomeType from ./bar.

settings_note: The issue names no compiler options or settings; no tsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project for the open file and its import.

files.source: issue body, Code block (the part after the '// bar.ts' marker)

repro.steps: Open foo.ts: 'const bar: Bar = {}' is reported (TS2741, property 'bar' is missing). Apply the quick fix 'Add missing properties'. Reported: the generated method 'bar: function (): SomeType' leaves SomeType unimported ('Cannot find name SomeType'); expected: SomeType is added to the import from ./bar. Probe: a fresh session on the edited files must neither report the targeted TS2741 nor any new error.
